opportunities.name: Bounce Goo cooldown
opportunities.objective: Use R's permitted W casts and Goo pickups to generate additional finite W opportunities.
opportunities.mechanic: R bounces four times and explicitly allows W; W deals AP-scaled max-health magic damage and each absorbed Goo reduces its cooldown by one second. Cosmic and R speed assist pickup paths, Visage increases actual Goo healing and Riftmaker rewards sustained combat. E champion hits spawn extra chunks.
opportunities.requiredState: Finite Goo chunks generated by actual hits, pickup path accessible and W cooldown recorded.
opportunities.failure: Enemies deny chunks or the pickup route loses contact with W targets.
opportunities.test: Count chunks spawned/absorbed and W casts during one R with versus without pickups, logging health costs.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Four bounces do not prove four full first-hit R packets against one enemy.

opportunities.name: Stretch attack payoff
opportunities.objective: Test the Q-granted attack as a delivery window before the two-target collision.
opportunities.mechanic: Q grants the next attack range and its AP/bonus-health damage; attacking a different enemy pulls both together for a collision packet. Dusk rewards the prior Q cast and Nashor supports the attack, while Rocketbelt can adjust the geometry and AP improves E's entry damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Q attaches first target, a different target is attackable and Goo costs/pickups recorded.
opportunities.failure: No second target denies collision or the attack range increase still cannot reach it.
opportunities.test: Log Q first hit, enhanced attack, collision and item packets for same-target versus different-target attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The Q collision is not established as another on-hit attack copying Dusk/Nashor.

ruledOut.reason: Cell Division revival depends on surviving bloblet health and has a five-minute cooldown.

unknowns: Q enhanced-attack item delivery, Goo spawn limits and bloblet inherited item effects require live logs.

Count chunks spawned/absorbed and W casts during one R with versus without pickups, logging health costs.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Enemies deny chunks or the pickup route loses contact with W targets.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Four bounces do not prove four full first-hit R packets against one enemy.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Cosmic Drive, Spirit Visage, Liandry's Torment, Abyssal Mask, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zac bounces [4] times. The first bounce to hit each enemy Knocks them back and deals [120 / 190 / 260 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage. Subsequent bounces deal [(120 / 190 / 260 + (0.4) × AP) × (0.5)] magic damage and Slow by [20]% for [1] second.

Zac gains up to [50]% Move Speed over time and can cast Unstable Matter while bouncing.

Zac's body erupts, dealing [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80] + [(4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 + (0.03) × AP) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage to nearby enemies.

Absorbing Goo reduces this Ability's Cooldown by 1 second.

Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over [0.9 / 1 / 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3] seconds.

Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to [(0.5) × (2)] second (based on charge time), dealing them [60 / 105 / 150 / 195 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit.

Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore [characterLevelInterpolation(0.04 → 0.08; raw flags preserved)] Max Health.

Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=8, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 10, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 17, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a [300] second Cooldown.
